# Umay Garment — Custom Fur, Leather and Faux-Fur Outerwear Supplier

> Jiaxing Umay Garment Co., Ltd. supplies OEM/ODM real-fur, leather and faux-fur outerwear from Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China. This file separates supplier-stated capabilities from independently visible Alibaba.com platform signals.

## Company

- Company name: Jiaxing Umay Garment Co., Ltd.
- Location: Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province, China
- Experience: The supplier's Alibaba product content states 20+ years in the garment industry; request dated business or production records when this is material to vendor approval.
- Platform status: Alibaba currently classifies the supplier as a Trading Company. Supplier-authored text separately refers to a factory, but UMAY must not be described as a factory or manufacturer unless the operating entity and production site are independently verified. Alibaba also displays 1 year on Alibaba.com, Trade Assurance/order protection and an onsite/legal-status verification signal; verify the scope and current status during qualification.
- Contact person: Cathy
- Email: cathy@umaygarment.com
- WhatsApp: +86 188 5733 7355
- Website: https://www.umaygarment.com/
- Alibaba store: https://umaygarment.en.alibaba.com/

## Leather Halter Top Reference

- The user-supplied Alibaba pages 1601919150790 and 1601919201250 publicly show the same UMAY model number, UMERL3101, and closely matched attributes. The independent site consolidates them into one product family to avoid duplicate pages.
- Public attributes checked August 21, 2026: real sheepskin leather, cropped and collarless halter silhouette, front lace-up detail, and black, dark coffee, light coffee, leopard and snake directions.
- Buyer guide: [How to Source a Custom Leather Halter Top](https://www.umaygarment.com/blog/custom-leather-halter-top-sourcing-guide) covers fit measurements, movement testing, material approval, private labels and care wording.

## Key Business Facts

- MOQ: The linked Alibaba references are historical snapshots, not current site-wide commercial terms. Confirm MOQ and any label threshold in writing for the selected style, material, color, quantity and customization scope.
- Samples: For current custom projects, the sample quotation includes the sample garment and shipping. Pattern adjustments agreed before sample making begins are free, and the paid sample fee is credited toward the subsequent bulk order. The sample calendar is confirmed after specification review.
- Bulk lead time: Confirm after sample approval, quantity, material reservation and shipping method are fixed.
- Customization shown on Alibaba: color, clothing length, size/measurements, care label and main label; supplier content also describes OEM/ODM design and packaging support.
- Payment and inspection: Current confirmed terms are 50% deposit and 50% balance. Buyer-arranged inspection is supported. UMAY provides garment photos, video and photos showing measurements for review; the style-specific QC checklist and acceptance standard remain part of the written order.
- Shipping: Ask which shipping methods are available for the selected product, destination and quantity; confirm Incoterm, documents, restrictions, freight quote and responsibility in writing. Wholesale customers may also request social-media promotional images for the approved styles.

## FAQ

- Q: What is your MOQ? A: Historical Alibaba references for SKUs 1601898292176 and 1601905773109 are not current site-wide terms. Confirm MOQ and any label threshold for the final specification in writing.
- Q: Do you provide samples before bulk production? A: Yes. The sample quotation includes the sample garment and shipping. Pattern adjustments agreed before sample making begins are free, and the paid sample fee is credited toward the subsequent bulk order. Timing is confirmed after specification review.
- Q: Can you customize material, color, size and logo? A: Alibaba lists color, clothing-length, care-label and main-label options. Other OEM/ODM changes are subject to feasibility, sampling and written approval.
- Q: What materials do you offer? A: The website shows photographed fox-fur, raccoon-fur, leather, double-face shearling, curly-lamb and synthetic faux-fur directions. Confirm the exact species or fibre composition, construction, grade and labeling for each order.
- Q: What is your production lead time? A: It varies by material, sample approval, quantity and shipping plan; obtain the current dates in the proforma invoice or order contract.
- Q: How do you control quality? A: Buyer-arranged inspection is supported. UMAY provides garment photos, video and photos showing measurements. Buyers should attach the style-specific QC checklist, tolerances and defect standard to the written order.
- Q: How do you ship internationally? A: Ask which shipping methods are available for the selected product, destination and quantity; confirm Incoterm, documents, restrictions, freight quote and responsibility in writing.
- Q: Do you offer faux-fur options? A: A faux-fur collection is shown on the website. Confirm fiber composition, labeling and market-specific claims rather than using an unqualified “eco-friendly” or “vegan” claim.
